name: rw_rowboat_r2
subject: a classic Stockholm wooden rowing boat (a 4 m clinker-built eka) seen exactly from the side: a varnished golden-brown wooden hull with overlapping planks, a white painted upper strake, a dark gunwale rail, the sheer rising gently to a pointed bow on the left and a narrow transom stern on the right; an adult man in a navy coat and a flat cap sits on the middle thwart facing the stern, rowing, the near oar from his hands down into the water
part_map: the long dark grey shape is the hull (exactly that length, its top edge the gunwale, rising a little at both ends), the light grey lines are the gunwale rail and one plank line, the round skin-coloured shape is the rower's head (exactly that size), the blue shape his coat and arms, the thin tan line the oar ending in its blade at the bottom left.
size_sentence: the boat is about three and a half dogs long, its side is about as high as the dog's legs above the water, and the seated man's head is a little higher than the dog's head. A real rowing boat and a grown man at true size next to the dog, not a toy and not a child.

slot.where: River Walk screens 8-9, the harbour: the two ROWBOAT movers (level/riverwalk.lua), drawn by Sp.drawRowboat (setpieces.lua); the hull is cut from this render, the rower comes from rw_rower and its rowing loop

extra: Image 2 shows approved sprites from this game at its pixel size. Draw the boat as carefully as they are drawn: every plank of the clinker hull a clean horizontal band with a lit top edge and a darker lower edge, each band in a 3 to 4 shade warm wood ramp, the plank seams straight and even; the white upper strake a clean band; the man's face, cap, coat folds and hands clearly drawn with few large shapes. No speckles, no grain noise, no stray pixels.
